vulnerabilityAlerts.description: security fixes skip the weekly window and the release-age wait

customManagers.description: tool versions in the Makefile, annotated with # renovate: comments

packageRules.description: group all non-major updates into one weekly PR, automerged once required checks pass
k8s libraries and controller-runtime must move together; own PR so a k8s break doesn't hold back everything else
go directive in go.mod and the golang builder image move together

Docker Hub often fails to return push dates for images with huge tag lists (golang), and Renovate then holds the update back forever. Age docker updates when a date is available, don't block when it isn't; they're digest-pinned anyway
the go directive in go.mod is a minimum-version constraint Renovate leaves alone by default; bump it so it moves with the builder image
majors carry breaking changes: separate PRs, never automerged
GitHub Actions majors: one PR instead of one per action. Not automerged — release.yml and docs.yml deploy steps don't run on PRs, so CI can't vouch for them
our own image in the chart: release.yml sets the tag at release time. Bumping it here would touch dist/chart, cut a release, and loop every week
